easy.q: How many movies are in the main Fast & Furious series, through 2023's Fast X?
easy.fact: The spinoff Hobbs & Shaw (2019) isn't counted.

easy.q: How many U.S. states have a shoreline on Lake Michigan?
easy.fact: It's the only Great Lake entirely inside the U.S.

easy.q: On July 4, 2026, the United States celebrated which birthday?
easy.fact: The Declaration of Independence was adopted on July 4, 1776.

easy.q: How many players does a baseball team have on the field on defense?
easy.fact: That's why a team's batting order also has nine spots.

easy.q: How many Pirates of the Caribbean movies have been released?
easy.fact: The first, The Curse of the Black Pearl, came out in 2003.

medium.q: To the nearest day, how long did NASA's Apollo 13 mission last?
medium.fact: It lasted 5 days, 22 hours and 54 minutes.

medium.q: To the nearest 10 miles, how long is New York's Long Island?
medium.fact: It stretches about 118 miles from New York Harbor to Montauk Point.

medium.q: How many feet long is a regulation pickleball court?
medium.fact: It's the same size as a doubles badminton court.

medium.q: In what year did Beyoncé release her first solo album, Dangerously in Love?
medium.fact: It won five Grammys, including Best Contemporary R&B Album.

medium.q: How many episodes of the original Star Trek series aired?
medium.fact: It ran for three seasons on NBC, from 1966 to 1969.

hard.q: In what year did Lewis and Clark's expedition set out from near St. Louis?
hard.fact: They reached the Pacific Ocean in November 1805.

hard.q: To the nearest mile, how long is Louisiana's Lake Pontchartrain Causeway?
hard.fact: For a stretch of about 8 miles, you can't see land in any direction.

hard.q: Secretariat won the 1973 Belmont Stakes by how many lengths?
hard.fact: His time of 2:24 is still the Belmont record.

hard.q: How many episodes of Parks and Recreation were made?
hard.fact: The show ran for seven seasons on NBC, from 2009 to 2015.
